entity_geography.text: ocx > ===== FILE: files/1337_9461617_unpacked/1_PLI145F Stenography and Transcription Services - Pre-Market Consultation.docx ===== Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) Provision of Stenography and Transcription Services for Public Sector Bodies 9th November 2026 Introduction As per the Prior Information Notice (PIN) published in October 2026, the Office of Government Procurement (OGP) intends to run a competitive procurement process for the provision of Stenography and Transcription Services in 2026/2027. As part of the procurement process, the OGP is issuing this Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) document and invites responses from Economic Operators in the stenography and transcription services market. This is a market sounding exercise to obtain market information on the provision of stenography and transcription services to assist in the development and structuring of the upcoming Request for Tenders. This is also an opportunity for market players to provide valuable information to the OGP in respect of any issues or challenges relevant to this market and to submit any suggestions which would enhance the provision of stenography and transcription services for Public Sector Bodies (PSBs) in Ireland. It is not a call for competition. Details of the procurement process pursuant to this

To ascertain the specific measures undertaken by the market to align with Ireland’s Climate Action Plan 2025 to become carbon neutral by no later than 2050 (Climate Action Plan 2025). Background to the Procurement Requirements The OGP is considering the establishment of the most appropriate, responsive, and effective procurement solution for the provision of professional stenography and transcription services to Public Service Bodies. The framework will support the accurate, secure, and timely capture of spoken communications across a wide range of official settings, with services provided by Economic Operators using their skills, experience, expertise, and professionalism to deliver value-added solutions. Services may include stenographic and court reporting, transcription, captioning, inquiry reporting, remote and hybrid hearing support, and secure transcript management for interviews, hearings, inquiries, tribunals, public consultations, committee meetings, disciplinary proceedings, investigations, conferences, workshops, stakeholder engagements, and other official proceedings. These services may be provided using traditional human transcription methods, AI-assisted transcription technologies, or a combination of both. Le pouvoir adjudicateur peut notamment demander aux soumissionnaires de régulariser leurs offres si celles-ci ne respectent pas les exigences formulées dans les documents de la consultation, ou parce qu’elles sont incomplètes, ou parce qu’elles méconnaissent la législation applicable notamment en matière sociale et environnementale, ou parce que les prix excèdent les crédits budgétaires alloués au marché public tels qu’ils ont été déterminés et établis avant le lancement de la procédure. Le délai octroyé par le pouvoir adjudicateur aux soumissionnaires pour régulariser leurs offres sera identique pour tous et ne saurait être supérieur à dix jours. Si pour assurer la continuité de service, la solution implique de la maintenance préventive, les opérations seront planifiées afin de ne pas gêner l’activité et les utilisateurs seront avisés 48 heures avant. Le cas échéant, la maintenance intègrera sans surcoût, les évolutions mineures de l’outil, sous réserve de l’acceptation des organismes utilisateurs. La maintenance comprend la main d’œuvre et les éventuels déplacements du titulaire nécessaire au bon fonctionnement de la solution. Une solution d’assistance en cas d’évolutions des besoins des Caf : Les évolutions pourront porter sur un changement de personnel en charge du traitement et un changement de nature et de typologie des courriers. En cas de changement des personnes en charge du traitement des courriers, il est demandé que les modifications d’habilitations soient à la main de l’administrateur de la Caf (pour garantir la réactivité). Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. Its use also creates important responsibilities for public bodies and their staff in relation to responsible use, data protection, information security, transparency, accountability and human oversight. The Local Government Management Agency (LGMA), on behalf of the local government sector, seeks to engage a suitably qualified provider to develop a suite of short, accessible online training modules providing baseline AI literacy and awareness training for local authority staff. ip_data_security.text: (LGMA), on behalf of the local government sector, seeks to engage a suitably qualified provider to develop a suite of short, accessible online training modules providing baseline AI literacy and awareness training for local authority staff. The purpose of the training is to establish a consistent baseline level of AI literacy across the sector and provide staff with the knowledge required to understand AI, recognise the responsibilities associated with its use, and use AI appropriately and responsibly within a public-service environment. The training suite will cover seven topics: AI fundamentals; Responsible AI; Public service obligations; Data protection considerations; Information security considerations; Human oversight; and Awareness of the EU AI Act. The training is intended as baseline awareness training for staff generally and is not intended to provide specialist, technical or role-specific AI training. This reflects the current sector approach of providing a universal AI literacy baseline separately from practical tool-specific enablement. The successful tenderer will work with the LGMA and its nominated representatives to agree the structure, learning objectives and detailed content of each module before development commences. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard. Situering van De Werkvennootschap en situering van de Opdracht De Werkvennootschap werkt o.a. samen met het departement Mobiliteit en Openbare Werken en het Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer om een aantal strategisch belangrijke mobiliteitsprojecten in Vlaanderen te realiseren. Via-Invest werd hiertoe op 9 mei 2017 omgevormd in een naamloze vennootschap van publiek recht, genoemd “De Werkvennootschap”, die als projecteigenaar meer slagkracht zal hebben. De Werkvennootschap heeft als enige aandeelhouder het Vlaamse Gewest. De Werkvennootschap heeft als opdracht complexe mobiliteitsinfrastructuur van strategisch belang te realiseren en te faciliteren voor het Vlaamse Gewest en publiekrechtelijke rechtspersonen. De Werkvennootschap wenst voor de ontwikkeling van systemen inzake geïntegreerde procesbeheersing in het kader van haar projecten beroep te doen op een dienstverlener via onderhavige Opdracht. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. EBVPD pildomas jį įkėlus interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Tiekėjas, pildydamas EBVPD, laukelyje „Procedūros tipas“ turi pasirinkti „Atvira“. Teikdamas pasiūlymą CVP IS priemonėmis šį EBVPD tiekėjas turi pridėti kartu su kitais pasiūlymo dokumentais (pasiūlymo pateikimo skiltyje „Prisegti dokumentus“). EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai kartu su pasiūlymu neteikiami. sla_onsite.text: ective of the competition is to secure a provider that can deliver high-quality, compliant training while ensuring value for money, consistency of delivery, and a positive learner experience. The anticipated procurement timeline from publication to contract award is approximately 4 to 6 weeks. The competition will be live on e-tenders for 3 weeks. In addition to the core training requirement, the tender will invite suppliers to propose online and blended learning delivery options where appropriate. Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/ACC-APG_Digital_IF_Call_for_Solutions_12Nov2026_Amendmnt_0002.docx ===== Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVE The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Office of Infrastructure Research & Development (HRDI) conducts and oversees research and development programs and projects that address critical highway infrastructure needs and priorities of national importance. Research studies focus on the design, materials, construction, operation, and preservation of highway pavements, bridges, and other structure

rs, engineers, and transportation agencies nationwide through the FHWA InfoHighway™ data portals (https://infohighway.fhwa.dot.gov). FHWA InfoHighway provides centralized access to research-quality infrastructure performance data, supporting data-driven pavement engineering, predictive modeling, and State DOT decision-making. The primary mission of the LPES contract is direct support for the LTPP program, consolidating field data collection, pavement research analytics, and long-term data management; additionally, the contract provides direct and indirect data support to related FHWA infrastructure research programs. 2 OBJECTIVE/SCOPE OF WORK The main objective of this contract is to provide highly specialized engineering services, including field survey operations, data quality management, scientific data curation, and technology transfer support services for the LTPP program and related highway infrastructure research initiatives. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the follo

staffing_team.text:
igible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the following criteria:

  • General Experience of the Firm (core business and years in business).
  • Experience in similar assignments of compatible size, complexity and technical specialty in the required area. Experience in development partner-financed contracts will be considered an advantage.
  • Firm’s in-house staffing resources with relevant expertise (extent of relevant expertise available among the staff who are on the firm’s regular payroll). 
  • Firm’s relevant organizational capabilities for the assignment.

Key Experts will not be evaluated during the assessment of Expressions of Interest.

Consultants are requested to submit but not limited to, the following supporting documents in support of the above-mentioned criteria:

(a) The Firm's Incorporation/Trade/Registration documents from the country of the firm; (b) JV agreement/letter of intent (if applicable); (c) Firm’s brochure;

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 9:00 to 16:00 hours.

The U.S. Government intends to award a contract to the responsible offeror representing best value using comparative evaluation authorized under FAR 13.106-2(b) (3). A comparative evaluation is defined as the act of comparing two or more offers in response to the RFQ. The item-by-item comparison is performed by comparing each offer directly to one another to determine which provides the best value to the Department. Comparative evaluation is NOT a low price technically acceptable (LPTA) or trade-off process. Prospective offers must still meet basic standards for responsibility at FAR 9.104 and solicitation compliance to be eligible for award. We intend to award a contract based on initial quotations, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies if there is a need to do so. The Procurement Office will not be holding a pre-quotation conference for this RFQ. However, we will accept questions regarding these requirements until November 16, 2026, via email: PristinaProcurement@state.gov . ks kitas pirkimo vykdytojo ir tiekėjo susirašinėjimas vykdomi tik CVP IS priemonėmis. 1.5. Tiekėjas, gavęs kvietimą dalyvauti konkrečiame pirkime, nėra įpareigotas teikti pasiūlymo. 1.6. The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

Therefore, the service is not fully subject to the provisions of Directive 2014/24/EU. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. Urząd oferuje wsparcie diagnostyczne w ramach swojej działalności, tym samym zapewniając bezpieczną eksploatację urzą- dzeń technicznych. Obecne zagrożenie epidemiologiczne rewiduje gotowość poszczegól- nych przedsiębiorstw do utrzymania ciągłości działania. Standard ISO 22301 ma więcej elementów i wymagań niż te, które wiążą się z podjęty- mi przez organizację działaniami w wyniku trwającej pandemii. Z kolej- nego artykułu dowiedzą się Państwo, jakie korzyści płyną z wdrożenia wymagań nowej ISO 22301. Zapraszamy do części pierwszej cyklu artykułów poświęconych za- gadnieniom bezpiecznej eksploatacji urządzeń transportu bliskie- go. Posługując się pojęciem resursu, ekspert UDT odpowiada na pytania, czy projektowany okres eksploatacji tych urządzeń nie został już przekroczony. W kolejnym artykule dotyczącym urządzeń ziębniczych autor przybli- ża pojawiający się coraz częściej szczególny przypadek wprowadzanej zmiany, związany z chęcią zwiększenia bezpieczeństwa amoniakalnej instalacji ziębniczej poprzez ograniczenie potencjalnych konsekwencji uwolnienia tego czynnika. Doświadczenia i obserwacje dotyczące różnic pomiędzy realizacją bez

ny, związany z chęcią zwiększenia bezpieczeństwa amoniakalnej instalacji ziębniczej poprzez ograniczenie potencjalnych konsekwencji uwolnienia tego czynnika. Doświadczenia i obserwacje dotyczące różnic pomiędzy realizacją bez- pośrednią analiz HAZOP a realizacją tych analiz w wersji on-line przed- stawia ekspert UDT w kolejnym materiale. Na tle wypracowanych doświadczeń w realizacji analiz bezpośrednich opisuje możliwości pro- wadzenia analiz zdalnie. W dalszej części numeru prezentujemy relację z wręczenia certyfikatów UDT-CERT, pierwszej w Polsce jednostki certyfikującej systemy, która otrzy- mała akredytację PCA w zakresie normy PN-EN ISO 50001. UDT-CERT oce- niła i potwierdziła pełne wdrożenie oraz stosowanie Systemu Zarządzania Energią w KGHM Polska Miedź S.A. oraz „Energetyka” sp. z o.o. Polecam również artykuł dotyczący dostępności cyfrowej, informacyjnej, komunikacyjnej i architektonicznej w UDT. W trudnym czasie pandemii warto pamiętać, że osoby ze szczególnymi potrzebami są obecne w na- szym otoczeniu, a wpływ na dostępność ma każdy z nas. Kolejny rok minął pod znakiem zmian w przepisach prawa dotyczą- cych funkcjonowania UDT. W artykule opisane są inicjatywy legislacyj- ne ukierunkowane z jednej strony na umożliwienie zachowania ciągłości działania przedsiębiorstw i ins

m kraju, a z drugiej na za- pewnienie bezpieczeństwa publicznego w obszarze funkcjonowania urządzeń technicznych. Wszystkim Czytelnikom życzę bezpiecznej zimy oraz szczęśliwego Nowego Roku. However, the deployment of nuclear technologies is not limited to technological advancement; it also requires full compliance with rigorous safety and quality standards that underpin trust in the nuclear energy sector. Modern nuclear facilities, due to their technical complexity, extended lifecy- cle, and critical importance to public safety and environmental protection, require a rigorous approach to quality management at every stage — from design and construction through to operation and eventual decommission- ing. For this reason, clearly defined and effectively implemented quality assurance (QA) systems are essential. QA systems are a core element of nuclear project management, ensuring not only high standards of execu- tion, but above all, the safe operation of nuclear facilities throughout their entire lifecycle. The manufacturing of elements for the nuclear energy sector is subject to exceptionally stringent requirements concerning quality, safety, and regulatory oversight. Given the potential consequences of equipment failure in environments involving ionizing radiation and high-pressure conditions, every element of nuclear infrastructure must comply with strict technical and legal stan- dards. Is it permissible for the company responsible for the design to obtain an EU-Type examination – design type certificate and the fabricator obtain an appropriate certifica- te for the manufacturing phase, e.g. Modules F (Conformity to type based on pressure equipment verification)? Anserw No. Even if different organisations can be involved, the directive clearly indica- tes that there can be only one manufacturer who is responsible for design, manufacture and conformity assessment of the pressure equipment. The manufacturer may subcontract tasks in relation to design and/or ma- nufacture but must retain overall control and have the necessary compe- tence to take the responsibility for the product. See also PED Guideline D-03. See also the ‘Blue Guide’on the Implementation of EU product rules. AP-1000 The nuclear power project currently the closest to construction stage in Poland is being developed by the consortium of Westinghouse Electric Company (WEC) and BECHTEL. The consortium is proposing the AP1000 pressurised water reactor (PWR), with an electrical output exceeding 1100 MWe (3400 MWt). This reactor design is already in commercial operation in both the United States and China. A distinguishing feature of the AP1000 are its passive safety systems, including the Passive Core Cooling System and the Passive Containment Cooling System, which rely on natural convection and gravity, rather than electrically powered pumps. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. The Contractor shall report all contract sales under this contract as follows: (1) The Contractor shall accurately report the dollar value, in U.S. dollars and rounded to the nearest whole dollar, of all sales under this contract by calendar quarter (January 1-March 31, April 1-June 30, July 1-September 30, and October 1-December 31). The dollar value of a sale is the price paid by the Schedule user for products and services on a Schedule task or delivery order. The reported contract sales value shall include the Industrial Funding Fee (IFF). The Contractor shall maintain a consistent accounting method of sales reporting, based on the Contractor's established commercial accounting practice. The acceptable points at which sales may be reported include– (i) Receipt of order; (ii) Shipment or delivery, as applicable; (iii) Issuance of an invoice; or (iv) Payment. (2) Contract sales shall be reported to FSS within 30 calendar days following the completion of each reporting quarter. The Contractor shall continue to furnish quarterly reports, including “zero” sales, through physical completion of the last outstanding task order or delivery order of the contract. (3) Reportable sales under the contract are those resulting from sales of contract items to authorized users unless the purchase was conducted pursuant to a separate contracting authority such as a Governmentwide Acquisition Contract (GWAC); a separately awarded FAR Part 12, FAR Part 13, FAR Part 14, or FAR Part 15 procurement; or a non-FAR contract. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers. The below table lists the TRL levels allowed under this BAA: Technical Domains of Interest FOUNDATIONAL GEOINT The Foundational GEOINT portion of the Research portfolio focuses on the creation of always accurate, high-resolution, continually updated representations of the earth’s properties, available on demand. Topics of interest in this domain include, but are not limited to, innovations advancing the GEOINT physical sciences in the areas of: (1) terrestrial/celestial reference frames; (2) earth gravitational models; (3) world magnetic models; (4) assured positioning, navigation and timing, and resilience; (5) geopositioning; (6) feature extraction, attribution, classification and modeling; (7) infrastructure models; (8) human geography and environmental models; (9) bathymetric/topological models; and (10) maritime environmental mapping. Topics of interest in this domain include, but are not limited to, innovations advancing the design and development of algorithms, components, and enabling technologies for systems in the areas of: (1) detection, tracking, and identification of the most challenging targets in complex environments; (2) sensing and real-time processing of both static and dynamic targets; (3) novel source exploitation and optimization: (4) collection technologies to optimize use of phenomenology sources; (5) space situational awareness; (6) information assurance, data integrity and quality validation; (7) error propagation modeling; and (8) multi-domain data aggregation. ANALYTIC TECHNOLOGIES The Analytic Technologies portion of the Research portfolio enhances the definition and utility of GEOINT by leveraging new sources of data and developing novel analytic techniques to deliver a geospatial dimension to multi-INT analytics, in particular to address emerging threats and mission domains. New data sources drive use of these technologies to provide accurate, timely, reliable, and scalable methods for data exploitation, integration, and analysis. Topics of interest in this domain include, but are not limited to, innovations in advanced processing techniques and enabling technologies for: (1) geospatial signatures detection, analysis, and tracking; (2) derivation of GEOINT from non-traditional data in cyberspace; (3) stand-off detection of counter proliferation and chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear and explosive activities; (4) water security; (5) image/video understanding and computer vision; (6) image and product standards development and enhancement; (7) automated target recognition; (8) temporal and activity

Esta obligación subsistirá aún después de finalizada la ejecución del contrato. Nothing in these Rules is intended to give any person who is not a Party any right to enforce any provision of the Rules, or to confer any legally protected benefit on any such person. Severability. If at any time any provision of the Rules becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any respect under the law of any jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of the Rules nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision under the law of any other jurisdiction shall in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Binding effect of determinations. Any certification or determination by NODES of a rate or amount under the Rules shall, in the absence of manifest error and except as otherwise set out in the Rules, be conclusive evidence of the matters to which it relates. In any proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Rules, the entries made in the accounts maintained by NODES will be prima facie evidence of the matters to which they relate. Non-waiver of rights. No failure of a party to exercise, nor any delay on its part in exercising, any of its rights (in whole or in part) under the Rules shall operate as a waiver of the party’s rights or remedies upon that or any subsequent occasion. Its approved status will lapse if the FSP no longer meets the conditions for approval. object of the contract In the context of the energy transition, electricity consumption is expected to rise significantly. New technologies, in the area of both consumption and production, such as solar panels, heat pumps, electric cars, batteries, etc. will bring challenges to the distribution system: namely, handling volatility in consumption and high peak loads on specific parts of this grid. Complementary to its usual methods (such as investment), Fluvius System Operator cv wants to develop flexibility and ancillary services as a methodology to keep the quality of its service high. Holder (MAH) is to be submitted with the first consignment. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

II) CONSIDERACIONES JURÍDICAS: PRIMERA.- El artículo 122, apartado 7º, de la LCSP establece que en la Administración General del Estado, sus organismos autónomos, entidades gestoras y servicios comunes de la Seguridad Social y demás entidades públicas estatales, la aprobación de los pliegos y los modelos requerirán el informe previo del Servicio Jurídico respectivo. SEGUNDA.- La disposición adicional octava, en su apartado e), de la Ley 7/1985, de 2 de abril, reguladora de las Bases del Régimen Local, dispone que las funciones que la legislación sobre contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a los Secretarios de los Ayuntamientos, corresponderán al titular de la asesoría jurídica, salvo las de formalización de los contratos en documento administrativo y, todo ello, en relación a los municipios de gran población. TERCERA.- El Reglamento de la Asesoría Jurídica del Ayuntamiento de Albacete (BOP núm. 16, de 10 de febrero de 2.014), en su artículo 2, apartado 2º, f), establece que corresponde a la Dirección de la Asesoría Jurídica la emisión de informe jurídico y demás funciones que la legislación de contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a la Secretar

a de las Bases del Régimen Local, dispone que las funciones que la legislación sobre contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a los Secretarios de los Ayuntamientos, corresponderán al titular de la asesoría jurídica, salvo las de formalización de los contratos en documento administrativo y, todo ello, en relación a los municipios de gran población. TERCERA.- El Reglamento de la Asesoría Jurídica del Ayuntamiento de Albacete (BOP núm. 16, de 10 de febrero de 2.014), en su artículo 2, apartado 2º, f), establece que corresponde a la Dirección de la Asesoría Jurídica la emisión de informe jurídico y demás funciones que la legislación de contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a la Secretaría General de los Ayuntamientos, salvo la de formalización de los contratos, correspondiéndole, en consecuencia, la emisión de informe en los expedientes de contratación y los acuerdos sobre interpretación, modificación y resolución de los contratos. Asimismo, en el artículo 9 del citado Reglamento, cuando trata de la función consultiva de la Asesoría Jurídica, en su apartado 2, letra d), establece que, en todo caso, tendrán carácter previo y preceptivo los informes relativos a expedientes de contratación y los acuerdos sobre interpretación, modificación y resolu

deliverables_scope.text: rativsystem – og det samme må tilbudte løsninger kunne gjøre. Servere patches normalt sett ila 2-3 dager etter de er sluppet. Alt av servere og klienter kjører Trend Vision One XDR. For løsninger i sikker sone kjøres fagsystemene på Citrix – og tilbudte onprem løsninger må dermed kunne kjøre på eksisterende Citrix infrastruktur. Løsninger som leveres skal benytte vårt eksisterende nettverk (LAN). Nettverksstandarder • 10/100/1000 BaseT nettverk • Power over ethernet( 802.3af eller 802.3at) • WIFI 802.11 g/n/ac • Reservert og ikke registrert IP-adresse fra DHCP server • Kryptering av all datakommunikasjon • Kamera må støtte Milestone og kunne benyttes på denne løsningen. • Adgangskontroll må støtte og kunne brukes fult ut med Lenel Onguard som Harstad kommune benytter som adgangskontroll-løsning. Visma Enterprise HRM benyttes som kildesystem for de ansatte. HRM er integrert mot Microsoft Active Directory via Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM). Dermed opprettes, endres og stenges brukerkontoer i AD automatisk basert på kildedata fra HRM. Enhetsgrupper som kan brukes til tilgangsstyring bygges og vedlikeholdes automatisk basert på organisasjonsstrukturen. Brukere må kunne importeres fra Active Directory eller integreres for pålogging via AD-konto til den enkelte

de feilen til tredjepart, begrunne overfor Kunden hvorfor han ikke kunne eller burde ha begrenset omfanget og/eller konsekvensene av slike feil og holde Kunden orientert om status for feilrettingen. Dersom Leverandøren er ansvarlig for installasjon av tredjepartsleveranse(r) som del av avtalen, skal Leverandøren teste at tredjepartstjenesten(e) fungerer etter feilretting i henhold til de retningslinjer Kunden eventuelt har angitt i bilag 1, jf. avtalens punkt 1.1. Dersom avtalt funksjonalitet i bilag 1 og 2 fjernes i tredjepartsleveranser og Leverandøren ikke evner å hindre dette, vil slikt tap av funksjonalitet kunne gi Kunden krav på prisavslag etter punkt 9.2.1 tredje ledd og/eller heving etter punkt 9.2.5 annet ledd. Det samme gjelder dersom avtalt funksjonalitet ikke er til stede i opprinnelig leveranse og dette ikke blir rettet innen rimelig tid, jf. avtalens punkt 9.2.1 fjerde ledd og punkt 9.2.5 tredje ledd. Kundens medvirkningsansvar Kunden skal bidra til å legge forholdene til rette for at Leverandøren skal få utført sine plikter etter denne avtalen. ETABLERING OG Gjennomføring av tjenesten Plan for etableringsfasen Der det er behov for en etableringsfase, skal Leverandøren, i samarbeid med Kunden, utarbeide en plan for denne. Planen skal omfatte beskrivelse av roller og

irkedag etter godkjenningsprøvens avslutning. Kunden kan ikke underkjenne tjenesten dersom feilen(e) er uvesentlige for Kundens bruk. C-feil anses som uvesentlige, hvis ikke flere C-feil samlet sett medfører at godkjennelse vil være klart urimelig. Kunden skal reklamere skriftlig innen rimelig tid etter at misligholdet er oppdaget eller burde vært oppdaget. The aptitudes and abilities measured by the ASVAB include General Science, Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, Mathematics Knowledge, Electronics Information, Auto Information, Shop Information, Mechanical Comprehension, and Assembling Objects. Test takers receive a standardized score from 1-100 for each of these subtests. The Army combines scores on the ASVAB subtests into composites, also known as aptitude areas (AAs) or line scores, to determine eligibility into each initial-entry MOS. For example, a Soldier would be eligible to enlist in the Fire Control Specialist MOS (13J) if they score an 83 on the Field Artillery composite AA that includes the subtests Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, and Mechanical Comprehension. There are currently 10 AA composites that are used to determine MOS eligibility: Clerical, Combat, Electronics, Field Artillery, General Maintenance, General Technical, Mechanical Maintenance, Operators and Food, Surveillance and Communications, and Skilled Technical. The Army combines scores on the ASVAB subtests into composites, also known as aptitude areas (AAs) or line scores, to determine eligibility into each initial-entry MOS. For example, a Soldier would be eligible to enlist in the Fire Control Specialist MOS (13J) if they score an 83 on the Field Artillery composite AA that includes the subtests Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, and Mechanical Comprehension. There are currently 10 AA composites that are used to determine MOS eligibility: Clerical, Combat, Electronics, Field Artillery, General Maintenance, General Technical, Mechanical Maintenance, Operators and Food, Surveillance and Communications, and Skilled Technical. Effective classification and assignment of Soldiers is dependent on being able to discriminate the different abilities of Soldiers based on how well they score on the AA composites of the ASVAB. The overarching objective of this effort is to conduct research to determine if the Army would benefit from updated AA composites used to determine MOS fit. The current project aims to identify potential redundancy within the current ASVAB AA composites,

The multi-domain operations (MDO) concept requires Army teams to operate semi-independently but also to utilize the capabilities across multiple domains to conduct sustained missions in highly contested environments. Additionally, high personnel turnover for teams is expected in the FOE as casualty counts increase, rapid teaming is required, and ad hoc teams become common. How will this impact the KSBs needed to effectively utilize SUAS in operations and training? Based on the identified KSBs, ARI is seeking science-based prototype(s) training and tools that can be validated and demonstrate the ability to improve SUAS operations. 4 A potential approach to addressing these research questions may be to identify KSBs needed by leaders and operators for effective SUAS operations. Then conduct a gap analysis with existing SUAS training to identify requirements to further develop SUAS KSBs. This would be supplemented by an in-depth analysis of current (e.g., the use of commercial drones in Ukraine) and evolving (e.g., micro drones and swarm drones) SUAS tactics, technology, and training methods to identify current and emerging gaps in training requirements. Small pilot studies would be conducted to validate the KSBs needed to perform desired SUAS maneuvers and tactics. Theory-based prototype training and training tools would be developed and validated to maximize the SUAS KSBs. Within the literature, creativity has been conceptualized and examined as both an antecedent (e.g., Yang & Hung, 2021; Zhang & Bartol, 2010) and an outcome (e.g., Liu et al., 2022; Tierney & Farmer, 2011). In a recent review by Lua et al. (2024), the authors discuss creativity behaviors like idea implementation, innovative behavior, and personal initiative. Teng et al. (2020) examined the relationship between creative self-efficacy and innovative behavior. In the study, the authors used Scott and Bruce’s (1994) measure of innovative behaviors which includes items such as “generates creative ideas” and “develops adequate plans and schedules for the implementation of new ideas” (p. 607). For the purpose of this effort, we are interested in creativity as an outcome and, more specifically, creative performance with technology. Creativity research is not novel to the U.S. Army, but largely exists at the antecedent level. Two previous job analysis projects included innovation and creativity in surveys of talent requirements (Boyle et al., 2022) and personnel characteristics (Royston & Lin, 2022) across military occupational specialties (MOS). Additional ARI efforts have examined divergent thinking (Russell et al., 2017) and creative thinking (Zaccaro et al., 2012). One means to identify high-potential candidates for training is to build a measure of the skills and abilities most typically associated with success across the military Cyber jobs. Cyber training for enlisted Soldiers is lengthy, challenging, and requires significant investment from the Army. The necessity of Cyber jobs has led to an increasing demand for quality personnel. By assessing the underlying skills and abilities associated with success in Cyber work, the Army can identify high- potential candidates, meet the increasing demand for these personnel, more accurately predict performance, and reduce attrition during the training process. Stenography is the process of creating an accurate, verbatim record of spoken words using specialist shorthand techniques and stenotype technology. Qualified stenographers attend proceedings in person or remotely and use computerised stenographic equipment to capture speech in real time. This enables the production of highly accurate transcripts, often available immediately upon completion of a hearing or proceeding. Depending on the requirements of the Framework Client, stenographers may also create audio recordings and maintain contemporaneous notes to support transcript verification and quality assurance processes. Transcription services involve the conversion of recorded audio and video content into written records. These services may be provided using traditional human transcription methods, AI-assisted transcription technologies, or a combination of both. Transcripts may be produced in verbatim, edited verbatim, or intelligent transcription formats, depending on the purpose and requirements of the assignment. All transcripts must be subject to appropriate quality assurance measures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements. Il n’est pas exigé que chaque membre du groupement ait la totalité des compétences techniques requises pour l’exécution du marché public. Dès lors, les éléments demandés sont appréciés globalement. Dans ce cas, l’opérateur économique produit les documents permettant d’attester de ses capacités professionnelles, techniques et financières. En outre, pour justifier qu’il dispose de ces capacités pour l’exécution du marché public, le candidat produit un engagement écrit de l’opérateur concerné. Pour les sociétés nouvellement créées, la preuve des capacités techniques, professionnelles et financières peut être apportée par tous moyens. Pour les opérateurs économiques étrangers, les documents équivalents peuvent être transmis et le pouvoir adjudicateur se réserve le droit d’en demander une traduction en langue française si nécessaire. Les prix renseignés dans le cadre du marché, en référence à l’annexe financière à l’acte d’engagement du marché comprennent la rémunération versée au titre des prestations effectuées. Ils constituent les prix maxima pour chaque prestation, en fonction du volume à réaliser sur une période donnée. Ils peuvent donner lieu exceptionnellement à une réduction complémentaire en fonction du volume de prestations à assurer. Les prix comprennent par ailleurs toutes les dépenses et autres frais liés à l’exécution des prestations attendues. Si pour assurer la continuité de service, la solution implique de la maintenance préventive, les opérations seront planifiées afin de ne pas gêner l’activité et les utilisateurs seront avisés 48 heures avant. Le cas échéant, la maintenance intègrera sans surcoût, les évolutions mineures de l’outil, sous réserve de l’acceptation des organismes utilisateurs. La maintenance comprend la main d’œuvre et les éventuels déplacements du titulaire nécessaire au bon fonctionnement de la solution. Une solution d’assistance en cas d’évolutions des besoins des Caf : Les évolutions pourront porter sur un changement de personnel en charge du traitement et un changement de nature et de typologie des courriers. En cas de changement des personnes en charge du traitement des courriers, il est demandé que les modifications d’habilitations soient à la main de l’administrateur de la Caf (pour garantir la réactivité). Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. entity_geography.text: 2_Eigenerklaerung_Bezug_Russland-0422.docx ===== Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. Its use also creates important responsibilities for public bodies and their staff in relation to responsible use, data protection, information security, transparency, accountability and human oversight. ip_data_security.text: (LGMA), on behalf of the local government sector, seeks to engage a suitably qualified provider to develop a suite of short, accessible online training modules providing baseline AI literacy and awareness training for local authority staff. The purpose of the training is to establish a consistent baseline level of AI literacy across the sector and provide staff with the knowledge required to understand AI, recognise the responsibilities associated with its use, and use AI appropriately and responsibly within a public-service environment. The training suite will cover seven topics: AI fundamentals; Responsible AI; Public service obligations; Data protection considerations; Information security considerations; Human oversight; and Awareness of the EU AI Act. The training is intended as baseline awareness training for staff generally and is not intended to provide specialist, technical or role-specific AI training. This reflects the current sector approach of providing a universal AI literacy baseline separately from practical tool-specific enablement. The successful tenderer will work with the LGMA and its nominated representatives to agree the structure, learning objectives and detailed content of each module before development commences. Scope of Works The proposed project comprises constructing a new two-storey training building (gross internal floor area 700 sqm approx.), alterations to the BA building & new training tower, new storage shed & gas compound and upgrade works to external yard. Situering van De Werkvennootschap en situering van de Opdracht De Werkvennootschap werkt o.a. samen met het departement Mobiliteit en Openbare Werken en het Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer om een aantal strategisch belangrijke mobiliteitsprojecten in Vlaanderen te realiseren. Via-Invest werd hiertoe op 9 mei 2017 omgevormd in een naamloze vennootschap van publiek recht, genoemd “De Werkvennootschap”, die als projecteigenaar meer slagkracht zal hebben. De Werkvennootschap heeft als enige aandeelhouder het Vlaamse Gewest. De Werkvennootschap heeft als opdracht complexe mobiliteitsinfrastructuur van strategisch belang te realiseren en te faciliteren voor het Vlaamse Gewest en publiekrechtelijke rechtspersonen. De Werkvennootschap wenst voor de ontwikkeling van systemen inzake geïntegreerde procesbeheersing in het kader van haar projecten beroep te doen op een dienstverlener via onderhavige Opdracht. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

Identification of energy efficiencies and the reduction of energy usage will contribute to achieving sustainability and environmental objectives in addition to contributing to the “bottom line”. Accurate monitoring and measurement of energy consumption is critical to the knowledge required to deploy a successful Energy Management System. Deploying a planned framework (e.g. ISO 50001) and auditing this enables the successful management and control of energy usage. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the follo

staffing_team.text:
igible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Expressions of Interest will be assessed based on the following criteria:

  • General Experience of the Firm (core business and years in business).
  • Experience in similar assignments of compatible size, complexity and technical specialty in the required area. Experience in development partner-financed contracts will be considered an advantage.
  • Firm’s in-house staffing resources with relevant expertise (extent of relevant expertise available among the staff who are on the firm’s regular payroll). 
  • Firm’s relevant organizational capabilities for the assignment.

Key Experts will not be evaluated during the assessment of Expressions of Interest.

Consultants are requested to submit but not limited to, the following supporting documents in support of the above-mentioned criteria:

(a) The Firm's Incorporation/Trade/Registration documents from the country of the firm; (b) JV agreement/letter of intent (if applicable); (c) Firm’s brochure;

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant’s Qualification-based Selection (CQS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 9:00 to 16:00 hours.
